title: Handle a missing object
summary: Groovy: Handle a missing object. Set name to "Asha".
introduction: ?. skips a property read on null. The Elvis operator ?: supplies a fallback for a false-like value.
learningObjectives: Handle a missing object with Groovy

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Groovy. Save each example as lesson.groovy and run groovy lesson.groovy.
The safe call returns null instead of calling length. Elvis then supplies 0.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Elvis uses Groovy truth, so it can replace empty strings and zero too.
